strings.zh: 模仿古代的精灵{NEWLINE}建造的东西。
strings.en: It’s a replica of an ancient Pokémon.
strings.notes: Same meaning as the US line (US 0080#0).

strings.zh: 小美『客人们,你们好呀。{NEWLINE}今天来这里,是来找小美玩的吗？
strings.en: Molly: Hello, visitors! Did you{NEWLINE}come here to play with Molly?

strings.zh: 小美『对呀,你也认识爸爸吗？
strings.en: Molly: Yep! Do you know Daddy too?

strings.zh: 阿金『人类……能变成精灵吗？
strings.en: Gold: Can... can people{NEWLINE}turn into Pokémon?

strings.zh: 小银『传说中被封印在{NEWLINE}阿鲁夫遗迹的强大精灵……{CLEAR}就是炎帝吗？
strings.en: Silver: The powerful Pokémon said to be{NEWLINE}sealed in the Ruins of Alph... is Entei?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『炎帝,你就是秀力博士吗？{NEWLINE}咱们在岩山隧道见过的,{CLEAR}你还记得我吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Entei, are you{NEWLINE}Professor Hale? We met in Rock{CLEAR}Tunnel. Do you remember me?

strings.zh: 水晶『这只精灵的样子,{NEWLINE}我记得画册上有画的……{CLEAR}确实是传说中的精灵——炎帝！
strings.en: Crystal: I remember seeing this{NEWLINE}Pokémon in a picture book... It really{CLEAR}is the legendary Pokémon, Entei!

strings.zh: 炎帝『Eeen——tei！{SCROLL}炎帝『未知图腾感受到了{NEWLINE}小美对父亲的思念,{CLEAR}所以把我从烧焦塔呼唤了过来。{CLEAR}从那时起,我就是小美的父亲了。
strings.en: Entei: Eeen-tei!{SCROLL}Entei: The Unown sensed Molly’s longing{NEWLINE}for her father, so they called me{CLEAR}here from the Burned Tower. From that{CLEAR}moment on, I have been Molly’s father.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你叫小美？{NEWLINE}你是研究所秀力博士的女儿？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You’re Molly? The{NEWLINE}daughter of Professor Hale{CLEAR}from the Research Center?

strings.zh: 小美『爸爸不要生气,{NEWLINE}他这么凶我不跟他玩了,{CLEAR}咱们回去吧。
strings.en: Molly: Don’t be mad, Daddy.{NEWLINE}He’s so mean, I’m not playing{CLEAR}with him. Let’s go back.

strings.zh: 小美『请问有什么事吗？
strings.en: Molly: Um, what is it?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你是阿鲁夫研究所{NEWLINE}秀力博士的女儿小美吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Are you Molly, the{NEWLINE}daughter of Professor Hale from{CLEAR}the Ruins of Alph Research Center?

strings.zh: 小美『对呀,我就是啊。
strings.en: Molly: Yep, that’s me.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『竟然在这遇到你。{NEWLINE}研究所的人找不到你了,都很担心呢。{CLEAR}你是怎么跑到这来的？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Fancy meeting you here.{NEWLINE}The people at the Research Center{CLEAR}can’t find you, and they’re all{CLEAR}worried. How did you end up here?

strings.zh: 小美『那天晚上爸爸来到研究所{NEWLINE}找到了小美,{CLEAR}然后我们就一起来到遗迹里面住下了。{CLEAR}没有跟叔叔们说一声就跑出来,{CLEAR}真的非常对不起。
strings.en: Molly: That night, Daddy came to the{NEWLINE}Research Center and found Molly, and{CLEAR}then we came to live inside the ruins{CLEAR}together. I ran off without telling{CLEAR}the grown-ups. I’m really sorry.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这个感觉……{NEWLINE}跟超梦一样的用意念传声？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: This feeling... It’s{NEWLINE}speaking with its mind, like Mewtwo?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『爸爸？{NEWLINE}失踪的秀力博士回来了？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Daddy? Professor Hale,{NEWLINE}who disappeared, came back?

strings.zh: 小美『嗯！是爸爸变成了炎帝的样子,{NEWLINE}把小美接到这里来的哦。
strings.en: Molly: Uh-huh! Daddy turned into{NEWLINE}Entei and came to bring Molly here!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『炎……帝？{NEWLINE}就是你身旁的这只精灵？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: En... tei? You mean{NEWLINE}this Pokémon next to you?

strings.zh: 小美『嗯！是爸爸变成的炎帝哦。
strings.en: Molly: Uh-huh! It’s{NEWLINE}Daddy, turned into Entei!

strings.zh: 炎帝『Eeen——tei！
strings.en: Entei: Eeen-tei!

strings.zh: 阿金『真是不可思议！{NEWLINE}我居然能听懂精灵的声音。
strings.en: Gold: That’s crazy! I can actually{NEWLINE}understand what a Pokémon’s saying!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『所以你并不是秀力博士了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So you’re not{NEWLINE}Professor Hale after all.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小美,你能听到吗？{NEWLINE}炎帝并不是秀力博士,{CLEAR}你的爸爸现在还下落不明呢。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Molly, can you hear{NEWLINE}me? Entei isn’t Professor{CLEAR}Hale. Your dad is still missing.

strings.zh: 小美『不,爸爸在我小时候{NEWLINE}就会给我讲炎帝的传说,{CLEAR}还会扮成炎帝给我骑,{CLEAR}现在爸爸真的变成炎帝回来了,{CLEAR}炎帝就是小美的爸爸！
strings.en: Molly: No! When Molly was little,{NEWLINE}Daddy used to tell me the legend{CLEAR}of Entei, and he’d pretend{CLEAR}to be Entei and give me rides.{SCROLL}Molly: Now Daddy really{NEWLINE}turned into Entei and came{CLEAR}back. Entei is Molly’s daddy!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小美,炎帝不是秀力博士,{NEWLINE}你如果想见父亲,{CLEAR}就要跟我们一起想办法出去……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Molly, Entei isn’t{NEWLINE}Professor Hale. If you want{CLEAR}to see your father, you need to{CLEAR}find a way out of here with us...

strings.zh: 炎帝『Eeen——tei！{SCROLL}炎帝『够了！住口！{NEWLINE}我就是小美的父亲！
strings.en: Entei: Eeen-tei!{SCROLL}Entei: Enough! Silence!{NEWLINE}I am Molly’s father!

strings.zh: 小银『消失了！？{NEWLINE}莫非那个石像……
strings.en: Silver: It vanished?!{NEWLINE}Could that statue...?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小银也消失了！？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Silver vanished too?!

strings.zh: 阿金『或许这就是离开的方法？{NEWLINE}我也试试！
strings.en: Gold: Maybe that’s the way{NEWLINE}out? I’m trying it too!

strings.zh: 水晶『前辈,咱们也去{NEWLINE}摸摸雕像试试吧,{CLEAR}或许真的能够出去呢。
strings.en: Crystal: Let’s try touching{NEWLINE}the statue too. Maybe it{CLEAR}really will get us out of here.

strings.zh: 阿金『你这……我……
strings.en: Gold: You... I...

strings.zh: 水晶『阿金,小银说的有道理,{NEWLINE}咱们还是先想办法离开这里吧。
strings.en: Crystal: Gold, Silver has a point. Let’s{NEWLINE}figure out how to get out of here first.

strings.zh: 阿金『哎呀,我最难应付学习委员了。
strings.en: Gold: Ugh, the Class Rep is the{NEWLINE}one person I can’t handle.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『阿金,水晶说的对。{NEWLINE}目前应该优先考虑如何离开这里。{CLEAR}刚才小美和炎帝从那边的洞口下去了,{CLEAR}咱们也追上去试试,{CLEAR}或许炎帝知道该怎么离开这里。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Gold, Crystal’s right. Right{NEWLINE}now, getting out of here comes first.{SCROLL}Molly and Entei just went down through{NEWLINE}that hole over there. Let’s go after{CLEAR}them. Maybe Entei knows how to get out.

strings.zh: 阿金『哎,虽然很不甘心,{NEWLINE}但是偶像和学习委员说的对,{CLEAR}只能先放这个吊眼红毛一马了。{SCROLL}阿金『我这就去找那个炎帝{NEWLINE}问出离开这里的方法！
strings.en: Gold: Man, it bugs me, but my idol{NEWLINE}and the Class Rep are right. Guess{CLEAR}I’ll have to let this scowling{CLEAR}redhead off the hook for now.{SCROLL}Gold: I’m gonna go find that Entei{NEWLINE}and make it tell us how to get out!

strings.zh: 小银『哼,我不会让你抢先出去的。
strings.en: Silver: Hmph. I won’t let{NEWLINE}you get out ahead of me.

strings.zh: 水晶『你们可不要中途干架啊！
strings.en: Crystal: Don’t you two start{NEWLINE}fighting halfway there!

strings.zh: 阿金『哈哈,这里是死路一条。{NEWLINE}没地方跑了吧？
strings.en: Gold: Ha ha! This is a dead{NEWLINE}end. Nowhere to run now, huh?

strings.zh: 小银『你这蠢货,既然是死路一条,{NEWLINE}你抓住我又怎么样,{CLEAR}你有办法从这里离开吗？
strings.en: Silver: You idiot. If it’s a dead{NEWLINE}end, what good does catching me do?{CLEAR}Do you even have a way out of here?

strings.zh: 水晶『说起来,咱们是从上面{NEWLINE}落到这个石室里的,{CLEAR}好像还真办没法返回哎……
strings.en: Crystal: Come to think of it, we fell{NEWLINE}into this chamber from above. It really{CLEAR}looks like there’s no way back...

strings.zh: 阿金『这都不是事！{NEWLINE}我的偶像,冠军{VAR:0103:0}可是在这里,{CLEAR}他这么厉害的人物{CLEAR}怎么可能会没有办法出去呢？
strings.en: Gold: No big deal! My idol,{NEWLINE}Champion {VAR:0103:0}, is right here!{CLEAR}There’s no way someone that{CLEAR}amazing doesn’t have a way out!
strings.notes: zh uses 他 for the Champion (no female variant); English is neutral.

strings.zh: 阿金『你说是吧,偶像？
strings.en: Gold: Right, Idol?

strings.zh: 可以用穿洞绳出去
strings.en: Use an Escape Rope

strings.zh: 可以用挖地洞出去
strings.en: Use Dig

strings.zh: 可以飞空出去
strings.en: Fly out

strings.zh: 其实我也不知道怎么出去
strings.en: I don’t know either

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『使用穿洞绳{NEWLINE}不就可以离开这里了吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Can’t we just use an{NEWLINE}Escape Rope to get out of here?

strings.zh: 小银『你这个联盟冠军是捡来的吗？{NEWLINE}要是能用穿洞绳,{CLEAR}我还至于被你们堵到这里？{SCROLL}小银『真不明白火箭队怎么会{NEWLINE}几次栽在你这种人手里。
strings.en: Silver: Did you find that League{NEWLINE}Champion title in a gutter somewhere? If{CLEAR}I could use an Escape Rope, would I{CLEAR}have let you corner me in here?{SCROLL}Silver: I really don’t get how Team{NEWLINE}Rocket kept losing to someone like you.
strings.notes: | RV032: meaning: 要是能用穿洞绳我还至于被你们堵到这里 = if I could, I wouldn't have let you corner me; 联盟冠军 restored

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像,不要拿我们寻开心啦。{NEWLINE}你一定有其他办法离开这里的。{CLEAR}对吧？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Gold: Idol, quit messing with us. You’ve{NEWLINE}got some other way out of here, right?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『使用挖洞技能,{NEWLINE}应该就能出去了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If we use Dig, we{NEWLINE}should be able to get out.

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像,这里不能使用穿洞绳,{NEWLINE}挖洞肯定也是行不通的。{SCROLL}阿金『你见多识广,{NEWLINE}一定还有其他办法出去,对吧？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Gold: Idol, Escape Ropes don’t work in{NEWLINE}here, so Dig’s not gonna work either.{SCROLL}Gold: You’ve seen it all. You’ve gotta{NEWLINE}have some other way out, right?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『让精灵用飞空术,{NEWLINE}托着我们从进来的洞口出去。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: We’ll have a Pokémon{NEWLINE}use Fly and carry us out{CLEAR}through the hole we came in by.

strings.zh: 水晶『前辈,我从进来的时候{NEWLINE}就感觉这里充满了神秘的力量,{CLEAR}精灵在这里使用飞空术的话,{CLEAR}可能会被神秘力量阻止,{CLEAR}没有办法飞到进来的洞口。
strings.en: Crystal: Ever since we came in,{NEWLINE}I’ve felt that this place is full of{CLEAR}mysterious power. If a Pokémon uses{CLEAR}Fly here, the power might stop it{CLEAR}from reaching the hole we came in by.

strings.zh: 水晶『前辈,您还有其他办法吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Crystal: Do you have any other ideas?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这……{NEWLINE}我也没有能出去的办法了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Well... I don’t{NEWLINE}have any way out either.

strings.zh: 阿金『哎！？连偶像都没办法出去吗！？
strings.en: Gold: Huh?! Not even my{NEWLINE}idol can get us out?!

strings.zh: 水晶『这下情况变得糟糕了……
strings.en: Crystal: Now we’re really in trouble...

strings.zh: 小美『呀,真的有好多客人啊！
strings.en: Molly: Oh, there really{NEWLINE}are lots of visitors!

strings.zh: 水晶『炎帝有这种能力吗？{NEWLINE}还是因为遗迹的力量我们才能听见……？
strings.en: Crystal: Can Entei do that? Or is it the{NEWLINE}ruins’ power that lets us hear it...?

strings.zh: 小银『这只精灵,有点意思。
strings.en: Silver: This Pokémon... is interesting.

strings.zh: 小美『你怎么可以欺负爸爸！
strings.en: Molly: How could you be mean to Daddy?!

strings.zh: 小美『走,爸爸！咱们不跟他们玩了！
strings.en: Molly: Come on, Daddy! We’re{NEWLINE}not playing with them anymore!

strings.zh: 要摸摸雕像吗？
strings.en: Touch the statue?

strings.zh: 坂木『根据对古代传说的研究,{NEWLINE}在这里吹响天界之笛的话,{CLEAR}就能到达阿尔宙斯沉睡的神殿了。
strings.en: Giovanni: According to research{NEWLINE}on the ancient legends, playing the{CLEAR}Azure Flute here will open the way{CLEAR}to the temple where Arceus sleeps.
strings.notes: #65–#116: post-game Arceus scene (Giovanni plays the Azure Flute in the hall; Archer/Cyrus/Charon gauntlet; Regigigas and Arceus taken with Special Ball / replica Master Ball).

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: {VAR:0100:1}, attack Giovanni!

strings.zh: 坂木『太迟了！
strings.en: Giovanni: Too late!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『情况紧迫,管不了那么多了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: This is urgent.{NEWLINE}I can’t hold back now!

strings.zh: 呜呜呜呜……{SCROLL}坂木吹响了天界之笛！
strings.en: Hoooooo...{SCROLL}Giovanni played the Azure Flute!

strings.zh: 坂木『这里就是{NEWLINE}阿尔宙斯沉睡的神殿吧……
strings.en: Giovanni: So this is the{NEWLINE}temple where Arceus sleeps...

strings.zh: 坂木『阿波罗、赤日、冥王！
strings.en: Giovanni: Archer, Cyrus, Charon!

strings.zh: 阿波罗、赤日、冥王『是,老大！
strings.en: Archer, Cyrus & Charon: Yes, Boss!

strings.zh: 坂木『我要去举行{NEWLINE}召唤阿尔宙斯的仪式,{CLEAR}你们给我拖住这个小子！
strings.en: Giovanni: I’m going to perform{NEWLINE}the ritual to summon Arceus.{CLEAR}Hold this brat off for me!

strings.zh: 阿波罗、赤日、冥王『是！
strings.en: Archer, Cyrus & Charon: Yes, sir!

strings.zh: 阿波罗『这是火箭队{NEWLINE}最重要的一次精灵捕捉。
strings.en: Archer: This is the most{NEWLINE}important Pokémon capture{CLEAR}in Team Rocket’s history.

strings.zh: 冥王『决不允许有人从中破坏。
strings.en: Charon: We won’t allow{NEWLINE}anyone to interfere.

strings.zh: 赤日『准备好迎接{NEWLINE}我们地狱的车轮战吧。
strings.en: Cyrus: Prepare yourself{NEWLINE}for our hellish gauntlet.

strings.zh: 战斗开始。{SCROLL}战斗完毕。
strings.en: The battle begins.{SCROLL}The battle is over.

strings.zh: 冥王『让你看看我最新的强化精灵！
strings.en: Charon: Let me show you my{NEWLINE}latest enhanced Pokémon!

strings.zh: 赤日『啊……不行了,我到此为止了。
strings.en: Cyrus: Ugh... No good.{NEWLINE}This is as far as I go.

strings.zh: 冥王『看来这些小畜生{NEWLINE}还需要进一步强化……
strings.en: Charon: It seems these little{NEWLINE}beasts need further enhancement...

strings.zh: 阿波罗『轮到我了,{NEWLINE}这次让你见识一下{CLEAR}晴天下的凤王！
strings.en: Archer: My turn. This time, I’ll{NEWLINE}show you Ho-Oh in harsh sunlight!

strings.zh: 阿波罗『咳咳……拖了这么久,{NEWLINE}老大那边应该完事了吧？
strings.en: Archer: *cough cough*... We’ve{NEWLINE}stalled long enough. The Boss{CLEAR}should be done by now, right?

strings.zh: 坂木『这孔武的身躯,坚实的臂膀……{NEWLINE}你就是传说中的精灵圣柱王吧？
strings.en: Giovanni: This mighty frame,{NEWLINE}those sturdy arms... You must be{CLEAR}the legendary Pokémon Regigigas.

strings.zh: 圣柱王『Reeee——gi！
strings.en: Regigigas: Reeee-gi!

strings.zh: 坂木『原以为你藏身在水都群岛,{NEWLINE}还害得我们好找。{CLEAR}结果你竟然在阿尔宙斯的神殿。{CLEAR}也好,就这样顺道把你给抓了吧。
strings.en: Giovanni: I thought you were hiding in{NEWLINE}the Alto Mare Islands, and we searched{CLEAR}high and low for you. Yet here you{CLEAR}are, in the temple of Arceus. Fine.{CLEAR}I’ll just catch you while I’m at it.

strings.zh: 圣柱王『Reeee——gi！{SCROLL}圣柱王的吼声中带着愤怒。
strings.en: Regigigas: Reeee-gi!{SCROLL}There’s anger in Regigigas’s roar.

strings.zh: 坂木『无聊的示威,去吧特制球。
strings.en: Giovanni: A pointless show{NEWLINE}of force. Go, Special Ball.

strings.zh: 坂木『这下不会再有碍事者了吧？
strings.en: Giovanni: Now no one{NEWLINE}else will get in my way.

strings.zh: 坂木『出来吧！{NEWLINE}帝牙卢卡、帕路奇亚、骑拉帝纳！
strings.en: Giovanni: Come out!{NEWLINE}Dialga, Palkia, Giratina!

strings.zh: 帝牙卢卡『Diaaa——ga！
strings.en: Dialga: Diaaa-ga!

strings.zh: 帕路奇亚『Paaa——kia！
strings.en: Palkia: Paaa-kia!

strings.zh: 骑拉帝纳『Giiii——ra！
strings.en: Giratina: Giiii-ra!

strings.zh: 坂木『根据地上的图案,{NEWLINE}站到你们自己的位置上。
strings.en: Giovanni: Take your places according{NEWLINE}to the pattern on the ground.

strings.zh: 坂木『这股震动……是阿尔宙斯{NEWLINE}感受到了我的召唤吗？{CLEAR}很好,快点现身吧阿尔宙斯,{CLEAR}臣服到我的脚下！
strings.en: Giovanni: This tremor... Has Arceus{NEWLINE}sensed my summons? Excellent. Show{CLEAR}yourself, Arceus, and kneel at my feet!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『真是耽误了不少时间,{NEWLINE}我得抓紧才行。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: That took way{NEWLINE}too long. I have to hurry.
{VAR:0103:0}: Stop! Giova...

strings.zh: 阿尔宙斯『Aaaaa——ceus！
strings.en: Arceus: Aaaaa-ceus!

strings.zh: 坂木『啊……何等惊人的气场,{NEWLINE}只要有了你的力量{CLEAR}我们火箭队一定可以称霸世界！
strings.en: Giovanni: Ah... What an incredible{NEWLINE}aura. With your power, Team{CLEAR}Rocket will surely rule the world!

strings.zh: 坂木『阿尔宙斯！我是帝牙卢卡、{NEWLINE}帕路奇亚、骑拉帝纳的主人,{CLEAR}是天界之笛的持有者。{CLEAR}我现在命令你,臣服到我的脚下,{CLEAR}成为我的随从！
strings.en: Giovanni: Arceus! I am the master{NEWLINE}of Dialga, Palkia and Giratina, and{CLEAR}the holder of the Azure Flute.{CLEAR}I command you now: kneel at my{CLEAR}feet and become my servant!

strings.zh: 阿尔宙斯『Aaaaa——ceus！{SCROLL}阿尔宙斯拒绝了特制球。
strings.en: Arceus: Aaaaa-ceus!{SCROLL}Arceus rejected the Special Ball.

strings.zh: 坂木『果然跟那些俗物不同。{NEWLINE}你是要见识到我的力量,{CLEAR}才肯向我臣服吗？
strings.en: Giovanni: So you truly are different{NEWLINE}from those common beasts. Must you see{CLEAR}my power before you will submit to me?

strings.zh: 坂木『很好,那就让你见识一下,{NEWLINE}我最得意的三只精灵吧。{CLEAR}出来吧,大针蜂、尼多王、铁甲暴龙！
strings.en: Giovanni: Very well. Then let me show{NEWLINE}you my three finest Pokémon. Come{CLEAR}out, Beedrill, Nidoking, Rhydon!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『阿尔宙斯,这个人无恶不作,{NEWLINE}你不可以成为他的伙伴啊！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Arceus, there’s no evil this{NEWLINE}man won’t commit!{CLEAR}You can’t become his partner!
strings.notes: | RV032: softened: 无恶不作 = commits every evil, not 'will stop at nothing'

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『阿尔宙斯在拒绝我？！{NEWLINE}这……是因为我没有{CLEAR}作为信物的天界之笛吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Arceus is rejecting{NEWLINE}me?! Is... is it because I don’t{CLEAR}have the Azure Flute as a token?

strings.zh: 坂木『哈哈哈,被你拼命想保护的{NEWLINE}阿尔宙斯狠狠推开,{CLEAR}你这个冠军还真是狼狈。
strings.en: Giovanni: Hah hah hah! Shoved{NEWLINE}away by the very Arceus you’re{CLEAR}so desperate to protect. What{CLEAR}a sorry sight for a Champion.

strings.zh: 坂木『好了阿尔宙斯,开始咱们的战斗吧！{NEWLINE}上啊,大针蜂、尼多王、铁甲暴龙！
strings.en: Giovanni: Now then, Arceus,{NEWLINE}let our battle begin! Go,{CLEAR}Beedrill, Nidoking, Rhydon!

strings.zh: 坂木『阿尔宙斯,就算是你,{NEWLINE}短时间内也拿不下我的三只王牌吧。{CLEAR}趁现在……用这个！
strings.en: Giovanni: Arceus, even you can’t{NEWLINE}take down my three aces in a hurry.{CLEAR}Now’s my chance... I’ll use this!

strings.zh: 坂木『这是用被打碎的大师球{NEWLINE}修复后制成的仿大师球,{CLEAR}比那个量产特制球可强多了,{CLEAR}就算是你也无法在分心的时候抵挡……
strings.en: Giovanni: This is a replica Master{NEWLINE}Ball, rebuilt from the shattered{CLEAR}Master Ball. It’s far stronger{CLEAR}than those mass-produced Special{CLEAR}Balls. Even you can’t resist it{CLEAR}while your attention is elsewhere...
strings.notes: 仿大师球 → ‘replica Master Ball’ (rebuilt from the shattered Master Ball).

strings.zh: 坂木『真是吓出我一身冷汗,{NEWLINE}但畜生终归是畜生,{CLEAR}以后你就只有任我驱使的份了。
strings.en: Giovanni: You had me in a cold{NEWLINE}sweat there. But a beast is{CLEAR}still a beast. From now on, you{CLEAR}exist only to do my bidding.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『坂木！{NEWLINE}把阿尔宙斯留下！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Giovanni! Leave Arceus here!

strings.zh: 坂木『还想再做最后的挣扎？{NEWLINE}真是无用功。{CLEAR}回去告诉达马兰奇,{CLEAR}准备迎接精灵联盟的末日吧。
strings.en: Giovanni: Still struggling to the{NEWLINE}bitter end? What a waste of effort.{CLEAR}Go back and tell Goodshow to prepare{CLEAR}for the end of the Pokémon League.

strings.zh: 坂木『帕路奇亚,带我们离开这里离。
strings.en: Giovanni: Palkia, take{NEWLINE}us away from here.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『唉……没想到即使拼尽全力,{NEWLINE}阿尔宙斯还是落入了坂木手中。{CLEAR}这下事情到了最糟糕的地步,{CLEAR}得赶紧回去向达马兰奇主席报告才行。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sigh... Even after giving it{NEWLINE}everything I had, Arceus still fell into{CLEAR}Giovanni’s hands. This is the worst{CLEAR}it could get. I have to hurry back{CLEAR}and report to President Goodshow.

strings.zh: 上次就是在这间大厅的中央{NEWLINE}吹响天界之笛才进入了{CLEAR}阿尔宙斯的神殿,{CLEAR}现在要再吹响天界之笛试试吗？
strings.en: Last time, playing the Azure Flute in{NEWLINE}the middle of this hall led to the temple{CLEAR}of Arceus. Play the Azure Flute again?

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}吹响了天界之笛。
strings.en: Hoooo...{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0} played the Azure Flute.
